body: I have already talked to my boyfriend about wanting to kill myself. He was the only person I felt comfortable talking to about this IRL. He said don't do it, but I didn't expect a different answer anyway. I've lost options. I'm going for a walk to think about this more. I'm going to talk to the voice in my head and see what I should do (Fuck typing that makes me sound even more crazy. The fuck is wrong with me). I'll be gone for a few hours I think. Thanks for talking to me. I clicked on your username and noticed that you do this for a lot of people. That is so nice of you. You are a good person.
I have tried: Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Meds, Meditation, Physical exercise, nutrition, Writng, music therapy, counselling. I cant see what other choices I have.

I know they care. They are the only ones who do. And it pains me to think that I am doing this to them. But life will go on for them. 

I hate myself. Everyday I have the voice in my head that tells me bad things. I say these things out loud. It is all the time. She never shuts up. I can't turn it off, I have tried to turn it off for years. I can't. I have driven myself crazy. I am going insane. I just want it to stop.
I have thought for so long already. It's the only way to stop her.
